facts.text: Quick, quick, I found a big crumb of cheese for supper. Hide it from Lucifer before he spots us at the table.
facts.why: Not Gus's line. On the quote page his lines include 'Duke-Duke! Key-key! Quick-quick!' and 'No, no, no! Cinderelly's slipper!' A crumb of cheese for supper is not in his dialogue, and this is printed in quote marks.

vibe.verdict: Pretty and on theme with the coach, slipper and midnight, but the tearoom is a stock layout and the villain's kitchen is an odd name for it.
missing: Jaq and Gus sewing Cinderella's dress from the stepsisters' cast-off beads and sash
Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Boo, the Fairy Godmother's spell (the garden)
Lucifer trapping Gus and the key under a bowl (the attic key scene)
Bruno the dog chasing Lucifer out of the house
Lady Tremaine pouring tea into the cup where Gus hides (the slipper scene)
The stepsisters tearing the dress apart (before the ball)
ideas: Change the 'Gus's corn fritters' note to 'Gus survived the teacup. Eat up.'
Swap 'Royal ball canapés' for 'Jaq and Gus's sugar bead biscuits', note 'Sewn from the stepsisters' leftovers.'
Rename the venue 'The Chateau Tea Room' instead of 'Lady Tremaine's Kitchen'.
Change the 'Cucumber finger sandwiches' note to 'Bruno chased Lucifer out of the house.'
